text: A15's order test, its rules logged before the census script is written (G47's last paragraph): line classes come from the spec files (instantiate, restrict, add-condition, add-step), the re-ruling spec (buffalobills-059 and floridagators-043 taken as J) and the absent rulings (a reject is an order line, ungraded for kind; an accept of kind none a limit; the one specification apart; a particular other), each checked against the written decision and kind; PO-tagged particulars count with the order. Classes: the order (O-*, M-*, S-O-*, S-M-*, absent rejects, PO), the bound (BOUND, S-BOUND), one call (J, EL-J), not a call (NC, EL-NC), not the room's attack (NA, EL-NA), one end (ONE, EL-ONE), after the close (AFTER, EL-AFTER), other, limit. By room: rooms showing each class, and each room once by that priority. The share: order rooms over episode rooms (the order or the bound), beside C2's 93 of 129 (0.721; 91 of 129 without joining) and the counterexample response's 36 of 129; also with one-call rooms added to the denominator. Also: the kind of the first attack among graded order lines (call or plan, act, encroachment), the order in words by room, R and AC marks among order lines, rooms showing both the order and the bound, and the classes of the bound's three story rooms (edmontonoilers, canucks, anarcho_capitalism) and the three support-transition rooms (Temple, completeanarchy, stlouis). Next: d3_a15_census.py

A15's wording decision under QD3-008's rule (a wording question without a correction is mine, logged): no correction was ruled, so A15 keeps its words, with no revision, no move and no finding to re-examine (findings --touching A15 returns none). Two wording questions go to D3c with their counts: (1) the mechanism's 'instead of, or before, building the room's own' does not name an attack after the room's work is complete; the census marks 11 such lines (AC), 7 of them order lines, and the connection's order holds there; (2) the bound names the attack call as the first call, while the commoner form in the rooms is a first call that places the room's work over another's (one call holding both, 58 rooms, against 9 showing the bound's pattern); the counterexample response's 36 of 129 may hold both forms. Census (d3_a15_census.py): 656 lines in 653 rooms; the order in 277 of 286 episode rooms (0.969), the bound only in 9 (0.031), no room showing both; with the 58 one-call rooms in the denominator, 277 of 344 (0.805); beside C2's 93 of 129 (0.721) and 91 of 129 without joining. The order in words in 7 rooms (ChronoTrigger, aceattorney, eve, gamindustri, minecraft, sabres, spain). Graded order rooms by the kind of attack: call or plan 109, act 15, encroachment 5; 146 absent rejects ungraded; 2 PO. R marks 14 among order lines. The bound's story rooms: edmontonoilers one call, canucks the bound, anarcho_capitalism the order; support transitions: Temple and stlouis the order, completeanarchy defence. Group close: accept 481, particular 6, reject 169; repaired lines accept share 0.727 against unrepaired 0.741. Next: the notes
